title: Good but date is wrong
body: The app is great. But the app is showing the wrong day. How do I solve this?
author: Lala6172

title: Almost perfect!
body: It’s almost what everyone needs to get everything done. It has a folder kind of thing for organization, journal, guide in everything you want to edit, etc. However, when the habits become too many, it’s too hectic to update because of the circle style of folder. Maybe it’s better if it’s a drop down for each folder. Or have an option to drag the habits by priority but still belong in its folder. This app is really good, but not easy enough when updating plenty of habits… As for the pricing, i think it’s too expensive… it can still be reduced by means of other plans…
author: LJ-31

title: More fee
body: I was charged $1 for the 3day trial on the website , and when I downloaded the app it asked me for another subscription, when I tried to click the restore purchase button it says they couldn’t find any purchase history… am so disappointed by this. I used the same email address I signed up for the website and it still wants to charge me more money despite already being charged.
author: wyesea

title: Not free
body: Not a free app. Forces you to pay.
author: Potassium663

title: Return my money!
body: Initially charged my card $1 for 3day trial but it doesn’t work then charged my card again for $39.9 again and still unsubscribe! The app still asking me to subscribe despite of this payment! Please refund my money! I won’t use this app. Its not integrated with the payment system.
author: fitzyoman

title: Excellent!
body: This app is so good, intuitive, and motivating. Just wish that the habits/titles are editable — and not just the details (time, frequency, place). But all in all, it’s really such a nice app. Thank you for creating this.
author: iskeaux

title: Very helpful and it’s user-friendly
body:
I love this app very much! User-friendly and very useful and helpful in building positive habits! 
I hope to get access to this app...forever!
author: Pat Medina
